name: Druidic Bond
body:
The bond between you and your animal companion has been greatly empowered.

Prerequisite(s): Animal companion or mount class feature.

Benefit: You are able to choose any animal as your animal companion or mount that a druid of your level would be able to choose (for example, a ranger with this feat could select an allosaurus as their animal companion). In addition, you treat your effective druid level as though it was 2 higher than it normally is.
